surfaces.name: Orbi engine: orbi CLI plus systemd/launchd timer runner (self-hosted)
GitHub Issues, labels and pull requests as the control surface
Orbi Cloud: hosted GitHub App with browser status page

claims.answer: Self-hosted engine is CLI-only (orbi) on Linux (systemd user session) and macOS (launchd, "not yet verified on real hardware"); work is driven through GitHub Issues and PRs in a browser. Orbi Cloud adds a browser status page that works on a phone. No desktop app, native mobile app or editor extension.

desktop_os.answer: No desktop client exists; the engine runs as a headless runner on Linux (systemd) and macOS (launchd). Windows is not listed in the prerequisites.

mobile_apps.answer: No native iOS or Android app; Orbi Cloud FAQ says everything happens in the browser and GitHub.

browser.answer: Orbi Cloud has a browser status page and GitHub is the primary control surface; the self-hosted engine has no web UI.

cli.answer: orbi CLI with add, suggest, draft, status, session, setup, doctor, check, install-units, milestone, notify and ticket subcommands.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension; a Claude plugin ships /orbi:ship and /orbi:status commands and issue-writing skills for Claude Code.

task_actions.answer: Start by labelling an Issue ai-ready or orbi add; steer by commenting on the Issue; review and approve the PR on GitHub; resume is automatic by the next tick; orbi status/session observe. Orbi Cloud adds Write a request, Let Orbi do this and status actions.

notifications.answer: Optional Telegram messages for blocked, needs-detail, awaiting-merge, human-review wait and merged; no push notifications beyond that.

cross_device_continuity.answer: State lives in GitHub Issues, labels and PRs, so any device with GitHub access sees and can steer the same delivery; Cloud status page works from any browser.

evidence.title: Operations
evidence.locator: Timers; CLI; Public surface; Worktrees; Failure recovery; Concurrency; Logs

evidence.title: Bounded search: desktop/mobile/web clients
evidence.locator: rg -i "electron|tauri|react.native|webview|flask|fastapi|uvicorn" src tools systemd launchd; windows|win32
evidence.finding: No desktop app, mobile app, editor extension or web UI in the engine repo; matches only a test ratchet tool and the optional metrics exporter HTTP server; Windows only appears in Pi idle handling comments. Orbi Cloud has its own browser status page documented separately.

evidence.title: Bounded search: API, MCP server, webhooks, SDK
evidence.finding: No webhook receiver, MCP server, HTTP API or SDK in the engine; the only MCP mention is a note about the pi-mcp-adapter Pi package; automation surface is the orbi CLI, GitHub labels and comments.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry
evidence.locator: rg -i "telemetry|posthog|sentry|analytics|mixpanel|segment" src docs 3rd systemd templates prompts integrations
evidence.finding: No telemetry or analytics code or documentation in the engine repo; outbound calls are GitHub (gh), the model endpoint, Telegram when configured, and the engine source update channel.

evidence.title: Bounded search: roles, SSO, presence
evidence.finding: No SSO, roles, presence or multi-user session features; authorization relies on GitHub repository permission (admin/write) for trusted comments and steering.

evidence.title: Bounded search: cost tracking
evidence.finding: No per-task cost, spend limit or budget code; matches are unrelated text. Orbi Cloud reports tokens per task in its status page (documented).

evidence.title: Bounded search: container or sandbox for agent
evidence.finding: The engine spawns Pi directly on the host as the Runner user in a git worktree; no per-task container, VM or OS sandbox. Docker is only a community wrapper around the whole runner.

evidence.title: Bounded search: other coding agent harnesses
evidence.locator: rg -i "claude code|codex cli|opencode|gemini cli|cursor agent|aider" src prompts
evidence.finding: No adapter for another coding agent CLI; only Pi is launched (pi_executable must accept Pi flags). Codex and ChatGPT are reachable as model providers through Pi.

evidence.title: Bounded search: indexing, multimodal, memory, rollback
evidence.finding: No repository indexing or embedding feature, no screenshot/recording capture, no cross-task memory store and no task revert command in the engine; matches are unrelated (CI triage text, KV-cache note, engine install rollback).

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and event triggers
evidence.finding: Only the five-minute timer tick; no cron-style task scheduler or event trigger besides labels polled on each tick (Orbi Cloud wakes the runner when ai-ready is added, per its FAQ).
